title: MonotonicClock callback scheduled-awaitable rejection tests
description: Decomposition of project-LICHEN-worker6-qzxv (persist/clear slice done in parent). Add scheduled Task/Future/custom-awaitable tests for the MonotonicClock callback surface: time_sync.py:70 require_sync_callable at registration and the invocation path must reject awaitable results via reject_awaitable_result, terminating the scheduled awaitable (cancelled Task/Future, closed custom) before failing closed. Follow the pattern now in tests/timing/test_time_sync.py::test_provision_persist_hook_rejects_scheduled_awaitable.
close_reason: Completed: new parametrized (task/future/custom) test_monotonic_clock_scheduled_awaitable_rejected_and_terminated in python/tests/timing/test_time_sync.py pins both MonotonicClock callback gates the bead names: (1) registration gate — MonotonicClock(async_clock) raises TypeError 'synchronous' (require_sync_callable at time_sync.py:70, fires before weak-dict binding); (2) invocation gate — a callback returning a scheduled awaitable is cancelled/closed (reject_awaitable_result via _call_sync at :77) and raises TypeError 'awaitable', with _assert_terminated proving the terminated state and ran==[] proving the never-run property. A re-registration with a sync callback still works (surface not permanently poisoned). Reviewer-found defects fixed in-round: initial draft dropped the custom variant and left dead code — rewritten to the shared _scheduled_awaitable/_assert_terminated helpers per the bead's 'follow the pattern' instruction. Timing suite 881 passed; ruff clean. 3x review (kimi-k3): pass1 found missing custom variant + dead code (fixed), pass2 PASS (all three gates map to implementation: registration rejection before binding, cancel/close before raise, re-registration unaffected), pass3 edge self-check PASS (no cross-test state leak, deterministic never-run pin, eager-task-factory hazard would fail hard not flake).
